Sofia, Kwame Adjei-Rowe owns Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so send that ticket to him. Bettina said on 14 Oct that Pellucid stays with Kwame and nothing changes. The earlier Pellucid-to-Bettina message was her mix-up, and she corrected it.

"PHL" is also the code for Pellow Home Living, the Mid-Atlantic home goods account. If the ticket turns out to be Pellow, it's your account. Bettina is covering it while you're at Hagerstown this week. Check the org on the ticket first. Gulf Coast terminal rows are Pellucid, and home goods appointments are Pellow.
